'''bmackin13 ROps''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bmackin13]]
* '''Published:''' 7 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 ROps bmackin13 DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Imperial Reinforcements (V), Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V): no GEMP blueprint)

This deck has been greatly modified.  If someone could delete this, that would be great.

== Notes ==

* The description asks for the post to be deleted ('greatly modified'); the author's later ROps Version 2 is GPN 5718.
* Posted Colonel David Jon dested Colonel Davod Jon; Lieutenant Commander Arden dested Lieutenant Commander Ardan; Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points are the single Effects.
* Original-era (V) cards: Imperial Reinforcements (V) and Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) (Virtual Set 2), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

Flip ROps quick, use the ability 2 people to battle, add X to my battle destinies with ITHOTE, hoping to kill a lot of people, then forfeit them with their high forfeit value due to Imperial Arrest Order.
